entries.title: Exodus 15:1
segments: ¶Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and spoke, saying: "I will sing to the LORD, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!

entries.title: Exodus 15:2
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and song, And He has become my salvation; He [is] my God, and I will praise Him; My father's God, and I will exalt Him.

entries.title: Exodus 15:3
segments: The LORD [is] a man of war; The LORD [is] His name.

entries.title: Exodus 15:4
segments: Pharaoh's chariots and his army He has cast into the sea; His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.

entries.title: Exodus 15:5
segments: The depths have covered them; They sank to the bottom like a stone.

entries.title: Exodus 15:6
segments: "Your right hand, O LORD, has become glorious in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has dashed the enemy in pieces.

entries.title: Exodus 15:7
segments: And in the greatness of Your excellence You have overthrown those who rose against You; You sent forth Your wrath; It consumed them like stubble.

entries.title: Exodus 15:8
segments: And with the blast of Your nostrils The waters were gathered together; The floods stood upright like a heap; The depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 15:9
segments: The enemy said, 'I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; My desire shall be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword, My hand shall destroy them.'

entries.title: Exodus 15:10
segments: You blew with Your wind, The sea covered them; They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

entries.title: Exodus 15:11
segments: "Who [is] like You, O LORD, among the gods? Who [is] like You, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?

entries.title: Exodus 15:12
segments: You stretched out Your right hand; The earth swallowed them.

entries.title: Exodus 15:13
segments: You in Your mercy have led forth The people whom You have redeemed; You have guided [them] in Your strength To Your holy habitation.

entries.title: Exodus 15:14
segments: "The people will hear [and] be afraid; Sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

entries.title: Exodus 15:15
segments: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; The mighty men of Moab, Trembling will take hold of them; All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away.

entries.title: Exodus 15:16
segments: Fear and dread will fall on them; By the greatness of Your arm They will be [as] still as a stone, Till Your people pass over, O LORD, Till the people pass over Whom You have purchased.

entries.title: Exodus 15:17
segments: You will bring them in and plant them In the mountain of Your inheritance, [In] the place, O LORD, [which] You have made For Your own dwelling, The sanctuary, O Lord, [which] Your hands have established.

entries.title: Exodus 15:18
segments: "The LORD shall reign forever and ever."

entries.title: Exodus 15:19
segments: For the horses of Pharaoh went with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea upon them. But the children of Israel went on dry [land] in the midst of the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 15:20
segments: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

entries.title: Exodus 15:21
segments: And Miriam answered them: "Sing to the LORD, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!"

entries.title: Exodus 15:22
segments: ¶So Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea; then they went out into the Wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness and found no water.

entries.title: Exodus 15:23
segments: Now when they came to Marah, they could not drink the waters of Marah, for they [were] bitter. Therefore the name of it was called Marah.

entries.title: Exodus 15:24
segments: And the people complained against Moses, saying, "What shall we drink?"

entries.title: Exodus 15:25
segments: So he cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a tree. When he cast [it] into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There He made a statute and an ordinance for them. And there He tested them,

entries.title: Exodus 15:26
segments: and said, "If you diligently heed the voice of the LORD your God and do what is right in His sight, give ear to His commandments and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have brought on the Egyptians. For I [am] the LORD who heals you."

entries.title: Exodus 15:27
segments: Then they came to Elim, where there [were] twelve wells of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there by the waters.
